architecture: API-backed global corpus + provenance-preserving local evidence graph

canonical_taxonomy.notes: MATERIA uses the live 3LR endpoint for browsing/search and keeps release metadata for reproducibility.

evidence_model.L2: ethnobotany, ethnomycology, ethnobiology and historical-use evidence
evidence_model.L3: human clinical observations, case reports and pharmacovigilance
evidence_model.L4: community phenomenology and first-hand community observations
evidence_model.prediction: computational, inferred or model-derived relationship; never silently promoted to experimental evidence

data_policy.taxonomy: Include accepted taxa and preserve synonym relationships.
data_policy.chemistry: Only attach a compound to an organism/material when a source explicitly supports the relationship.
data_policy.morphology: Preserve measured traits, measurement context, developmental state and provenance; do not infer pharmacological meaning from morphology alone.
data_policy.preparation: Preserve tissue, extraction, processing, formulation and other preparation variables.
data_policy.evidence: Traditional use, community phenomenology, clinical evidence and primary experimental evidence remain separate provenance layers.
data_policy.safety: Interactions, adverse events, toxicity, adulteration and uncertainty are first-class relationships.
data_policy.authenticity: Preserve labeled identity separately from authenticated identity when substitution or misidentification is possible.
data_policy.completeness: Global taxonomy is browsable through the live provider rather than copied into a single GitHub Pages JSON payload.
